english_text: Negotiate! Parley! As only the woken ones can.
note: Direct Toll of the Warden text proving the Parley/tile objective.

english_text: If it is in battle that you excel, join the fighting at the van, and try to weaken both sides into submission, taking care not to hand victory to either one. Yet if you abhor violence, as I do, speak with the shamans, and convince them to play the tiles. If you can best them at parley, they may lay down their staves.
note: Direct Toll of the Warden text proving the Parley/tile objective.

english_text: Yet if you abhor violence, as I do, speak with the shamans, and convince them to play the tiles.
note: Direct Toll of the Warden text proving the Parley/tile objective.

english_text: If you can best them at parley, they may lay down their staves.
note: Direct Toll of the Warden text proving the Parley/tile objective.

english_text: Those ones would play the tiles, those ones would trade their crystals-but no longer...
note: Direct Toll of the Warden text proving the Parley/tile objective.

english_text: Yes, yes, I see you were successful in bringing back a sizeable sack of crystals-but, from what I hear, [@1A(1)]that[@1A(0)] was more a matter of luck than judgment. If I recall Nananoby's account correctly, your negotiations with the beast tribes were nothing short of a complete and utter disaster.
note: Follow-up evidence that the negotiation attempt affects the quest narrative.

english_text: You have my thanks, [@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)]. And remember, you are not to attempt this mission alone. The matter is too important to permit such risk. You [@1A(1)]must[@1A(0)] promise me you will contact your Path companion before you quit Ul'dah.
note: Minfilia directs the player to contact the Path companion using the linkpearl.

english_text: You and your Path companion have been entrusted with a task of great import. Contact [@2B($EA(1))] using our linkpearl and make haste for Gridania.
note: Minfilia directs the player to contact the Path companion using the linkpearl.

english_text: Sylphs, you say? So we would be [@1A(1)]helping[@1A(0)] a beast tribe? Do you think that wise?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Help the sylphs? Those funny little beastmen with the flowers on their heads? Do you honestly think that's a good idea? They [@1A(1)]are[@1A(0)] beastmen, you know.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: ...Sylphs? They are not of the five races. Do you really think it wise to aid a beast tribe?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Sylphs? But... Do you think this wise?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: S-S-S-Sylphs! But they are b-b-b-beastmen! Their ways are strange and their magicks potent! You [@1A(1)]do[@1A(0)] know they kidnap children and keep them wrapped up in leaves until they turn into one of [@1A(1)]them[@1A(0)], don't you!? It's [@1A(1)]true![@1A(0)] My mother told me about it once, wh-when I'd been naughty! C-Can't we just stay here in Ul'dah?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Saving sylvan sprites from an invasion of imperial invaders!? Might you be mad?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Ah..."sylphs." Such a pretty word. I do so love how it slides off the tongue. If "beast tribe" felt as good in my mouth, I daresay I would not have my doubts about them! But tell me honestly, do you think it wise to help these creatures?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Sylphs? They be one o' them "beast tribes," no? Never quite saw why they was called that. Aye, they look different, but no more'n a 'Fell and a Roegie do.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Want me to lend a helping hand to a bloody [@1A(1)]beast tribe[@1A(0)], now, do you!? Well, I would if I could, [@IF($E9(4),lass,mate)], but one's wrapped 'round a cup of mead, while the other's full of a maiden's rump-and it seems I've only got the pair!
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Though it [@1A(1)]would[@1A(0)] be a rare opportunity to take up arms against the Empire... Very well! You may count on my blade!
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: That said, I've never been one to ignore a cry for help, be it from man [@1A(1)]or[@1A(0)] beast. And you say the [@1A(1)]Empire's[@1A(0)] involved, too? Gods...it all sounds so exciting!
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Yet I must admit, an opportunity to work against the Empire intrigues me.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: No. You are right. I will not allow myself to judge those of whom I know naught. That would make me no better than the Empire.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Oh, but that's just what she'd expect of me, isn't it? Well then, perhaps it's time I proved her wrong! Yes! Perhaps it's time I stood toe-to-toe with the Empire, and spat in its face! Or maybe just in its general direction...from behind a tree.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Then again, actively engaging our most evil and enigmatic enemy, the Empire, [@1A(1)]could[@1A(0)] prove rousingly rewarding!
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Of course, if we [@1A(1)]must[@1A(0)] get into bed with either the sylphs or the Empire...I'd take the beasts over the machines any night of the week. We're creatures of passion, not precision-aren't we, [@SPLIT([@STRING($EB(1))], ,1)]?
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Anyroad, I'll gladly do me bit for th' cause!
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.

english_text: Then again, I ain't one to shy away from a chance to bloody the Empire's nose.
note: NPC Linkpearl message pack row used by man206 NPCLS_MSGS.
